comment: Canonical machine-path ban set for the public docs gates. scripts/check-docs.mjs and scripts/release-check.ps1 both read this file, so a durable doc cannot pass one gate and fail the other on the same path. Entries are regular-expression source text shared by the JavaScript and .NET engines; Select-String and RegExp are case-insensitive on these. The whole author-machine root C:\Inference is banned with no exceptions (FR-15, operator ruling 2026-11-06): the harness ships no default under it.
testSourceBansComment: Scoped ban set for test and source trees (src, tests, examples), read by scripts/check-test-paths.mjs only; the docs gates above keep their own set unchanged. The F: pattern names the operator's model-store drive: test fixtures must stay neutral relative paths, and the card suites read paths only from SIMPLEHARN_T_* env vars whose operator-local defaults live in the private handoff preflight scripts. The release-directory markers of the docs set above (_release_v, _test-, SimpleHar-SE_release, SimpleHar-SE_test) are excluded here on purpose: they name build and release output directories, not authored source text, so they would false-positive on legitimate source references.
